name: icedq-mcp
description: Connect to iceDQ for data quality management - tools for validation, checksum, recon, pushdown, duplicate rules, file connectors, workflows, schedules, and data exploration
long_description:
Comprehensive MCP integration for iceDQ - the end-to-end Data Reliability Platform. 48 tools covering the full data quality lifecycle.

**Rule Creation**
- **Validation Rules** - Row-level checks: NotNull, Format, ValidValues, Length, Date, Custom Groovy
- **Duplicate Rules** - Detect duplicates on business keys; handles non-enforcing databases (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
- **Pushdown Rules** - SQL-driven aggregate validation: GROUP BY, JOINs, referential integrity
- **Checksum Rules** - Cross-source numeric comparison (COUNT, SUM, AVG) between two connections
- **Recon Rules** - Row-level cross-source reconciliation with AI-powered join key and column mapping

**Rule Management**
- **Update Rules** - Add/remove checks, change source tables on existing rules
- **Get Rule Details** - Inspect rule configuration, checks, and metadata
- **Execute Rules** - Run one or more rules on demand; monitor per-run status
- **Exception Reports** - View row-level failure details for any rule run
- **Run History** - Paginated execution history for rules, workflows, and schedules

**Connections & Data Exploration**
- **Test Connection** - Verify connectivity and credentials before use
- **Browse Metadata** - Navigate databases, schemas, tables, and columns
- **Sample & Profile Data** - Fetch sample rows and generate profiling statistics
- **AI Check Suggestions** - Intelligent quality check recommendations from data profiling

**Workflows & Schedules**
- **Workflows** - Create and manage multi-rule pipelines (sequential or parallel)
- **Schedules** - One-time, daily, or weekly triggers with timezone support; execute on demand
- **Parameters** - Reusable configuration values (thresholds, date ranges, reference data)

**Data Warehouse 
- **Warehouse Queries** - Execute structured queries with filtering and aggregation

All data is processed locally.

base_url.title: iceDQ Base URL
base_url.description: The base URL of your iceDQ instance (e.g., https://app.icedq.net)

realm.title: Realm Name
realm.description: The authentication realm name (e.g., icedq or iam.icedq)

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth client ID for API authentication

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for API authentication.

auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description: Authentication method. Use 'username_password' to authenticate with your iceDQ username and password.

request_timeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
request_timeout.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL Certificates
verify_ssl.description: Enable SSL certificate verification. Set to false for self-signed certificates (testing only)

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces in the iceDQ instance. Returns workspace metadata including id, name, accountId, status, createdBy, and createdAt. Starting point for any iceDQ workflow — workspaceId is required by all other tools.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all data source connections in a workspace. Returns connection metadata including id, name, connectorId, type, status (ACTIVE/BROKEN/INCOMPLETE), serviceProvider, and authType. Only ACTIVE connections can be queried. Supports pagination.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Test the connectivity of an iceDQ connection. Verifies the connection is reachable and credentials are valid. Use connectionId from list_connections.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in a workspace. Returns folder hierarchy and metadata (id, name, path, parentId, hasChild, state). Use nameFilter for partial-match search. Use folderId when creating rules, workflows, or schedules.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List and search rules in a workspace (Validation, Recon, Duplicate, Pushdown, Checksum). Supports filters: folderId (exact), nameFilter (partial), stateFilter (Published/Draft/Deleted), ruleTypeFilter. Results paginated by most recently updated.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder to organize rules, workflows, schedules, and parameters. Supports parent (root) and child (nested) folders. Folder names must be alphanumeric with underscores only.

tools.name: move_rules
tools.description: Move one or more rules to a different folder within a workspace. Async operation — returns taskInstanceId immediately. Always call check_task_status afterward to confirm completion.

tools.name: move_workflows
tools.description: Move one or more workflows to a different destination folder. Async operation — returns taskInstanceId. Always call check_task_status to confirm completion.

tools.name: check_task_status
tools.description: Check status of an async task (rule/workflow moves). Returns status (Completed/Running/Failed/Pending), duration, and affected entities. Always call after move_rules or move_workflows. Wait 2-3 seconds before first check.

tools.name: get_database_metadata
tools.description: Get database metadata and connection details for a connection. Returns connection info and database capabilities.

tools.name: fetch_sample_data
tools.description: Fetch real sample data by executing SQL on the database. Supports Table mode (schema+table) or Custom SQL mode. Returns actual rows with column metadata. Use after list_columns to explore data.

tools.name: profile_data
tools.description: Analyze sample data to generate profiling statistics per column: nullCount, nullPercentage, uniqueCount, dataType. Use after fetch_sample_data. Feed results to suggest_quality_checks.

tools.name: suggest_quality_checks
tools.description: AI-powered analysis of profiled data to suggest row-level quality checks compatible with create_validation_rule (NotNull, ValidValues, Format, Length). Returns a checksJson string — pass it directly to create_validation_rule.

tools.name: create_validation_rule
tools.description: Create a row-level validation rule with built-in checks: NotNull, ValidValues, Format (Email/Phone/SSN/ZipCode/URL/IP), Length, Date, Custom Groovy. Combine ALL checks for the same table into ONE rule. Published immediately.

tools.name: create_duplicate_rule
tools.description: Create a duplicate detection rule for single or multiple columns. Supports Table mode and Custom SQL mode. For non-enforcing platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) check declared PKs too. Published immediately.

tools.name: create_pushdown_rule
tools.description: Create a SQL-driven pushdown rule for aggregate/batch validation. SQL returns failures: 0 rows = pass, N rows = fail. Use for: GROUP BY/HAVING duplicates, LEFT JOIN referential integrity, cross-table checks. NOT for simple column checks.

tools.name: create_checksum_rule
tools.description: Create a cross-source checksum rule comparing a single numeric value (COUNT, SUM, AVG) between source and target connections. Each SQL must return 1 row, 1 numeric column. Supports auto-generated COUNT(*) or custom SQL.

tools.name: analyze_recon_mapping
tools.description: Analyze source and target table columns to suggest join keys and column comparison checks for reconciliation. Returns confidence-scored suggestions. ALWAYS call this before create_recon_rule.

tools.name: create_recon_rule
tools.description: Create a row-level cross-source reconciliation rule. Compares rows between source and target using join keys and column checks. Detects orphaned rows (a-b, b-a) and column differences (Xp). ALWAYS call analyze_recon_mapping first.

tools.name: update_rule
tools.description: Update an existing rule (Validation, Duplicate, Recon, Checksum, Pushdown). Auto-detects rule type. Supports renaming, changing source/target datasets, adding/removing checks, and updating join keys. Rule is published after every successful update.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Fetch full details of a rule by ID or name. Returns rule configuration, checks, state, metadata, and source connection info. Use before update_rule to inspect current configuration.

tools.name: execute_rule
tools.description: Execute a rule or workflow asynchronously. Returns instanceId. Use check_workflow_run_status to monitor progress, then get_workflow_run_result for detailed results. Supports Validation, Duplicate, Recon, Checksum, Pushdown rules, and workflows.

tools.name: check_workflow_run_status
tools.description: Check the current execution status of a workflow run using its instanceId. Statuses: Running, Success, Warning, Pending. Use after execute_rule to monitor async execution progress.

tools.name: get_workflow_run_result
tools.description: Retrieve detailed results of a completed workflow run: per-activity status, exit codes, source/target record counts, and error details. Call after check_workflow_run_status confirms completion.

tools.name: get_rule_workflow_run_history
tools.description: Retrieve execution history for a rule or workflow. Returns run rows: workflowInstanceId, objectInstanceId, start/end timestamps, status, exitCode, error, instanceSummary. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_checks_exception_report
tools.description: Retrieve row-level failure details for a rule run. Returns the specific rows that failed each check, with column values and failure reasons. Use after get_rule_workflow_run_history to get the instanceId.

tools.name: get_exception_report_url
tools.description: Returns the iceDQ UI URL to view the exception report for an executed rule or workflow instance. Requires objectId, instanceId (objectInstanceId), and entityType ('rule' or 'workflow').

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a new workflow to execute multiple rules sequentially. Each rule becomes an ExecuteRule activity with automatic index assignment. Use list_rules to find rule IDs.

tools.name: add_rules_to_workflow
tools.description: Add rules to an existing workflow. Fetches current workflow configuration, appends new ExecuteRule activities, and re-indexes automatically. Use list_rules to find rule IDs.

tools.name: remove_rules_from_workflow
tools.description: Remove rules from an existing workflow. Fetches current configuration, filters out specified rules, and re-indexes remaining activities. Returns updated activity count.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List all workflows in a workspace. Returns workflow metadata including id, name, template, workflowType, isActive, and state. Supports pagination.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule to automatically run rules or workflows. Supports Onetime, Daily (hourly interval), and Weekly recurrence with timezone support.

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List all schedules in a workspace with pagination. Returns schedule metadata including trigger configuration and associated rules.

tools.name: modify_schedule
tools.description: Modify an existing schedule's configuration: name, timing, recurrence pattern, timezone, and associated rule. Use list_schedules to get scheduleId first.

tools.name: add_rules_workflows_to_schedule
tools.description: Add additional rules and/or workflows to an existing schedule. Merges new jobs with existing schedule configuration. Supports batch addition.

tools.name: execute_schedule
tools.description: Execute a schedule on demand. Fetches the existing schedule configuration, executes it, and returns the schedule ID and name.

tools.name: get_scheduler_runs_history
tools.description: Retrieve the execution history of scheduled jobs. Returns paginated list of past scheduler run instances with status, timestamps, and task information.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List available databases for a connection. Uses cached results by default; retries without cache automatically on cache misses.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas for a connection (optionally within a database). Uses cached results by default; retries without cache on misses.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables for a schema (and optional database). Uses cached results by default; retries without cache on misses.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.description: List column metadata for a table (databaseName optional). Uses cached results by default; retries without cache on misses.

tools.name: create_parameter
tools.description: Create a reusable parameter in a workspace folder. A parameter holds key-value pairs for use in rules, workflows, and schedules (thresholds, date ranges, status codes). Alphanumeric + underscore names only.

tools.name: update_parameter
tools.description: Update an existing parameter's name, description, or key-value pairs. Full update — provide the complete parameters array. Any key-value pairs not included will be removed.

tools.name: parse_csv_and_create_parameter
tools.description: Parse a CSV file and create a parameter from its contents. Combines CSV upload/parsing and parameter creation. Useful for bulk-loading reference data into iceDQ parameters.

tools.name: datawarehouse_query_schema
tools.description: Get the data warehouse query schema definition. Returns available datasets, columns, metrics, dimensions, named joins, derived columns, and supported operators. Call first in a fresh session before datawarehouse_query_executor.

tools.name: validate_and_explain_structured
tools.description: Validate a structured query payload and explain what SQL it will generate (dry-run, no execution). Use before datawarehouse_query_executor to verify complex queries.

tools.name: datawarehouse_query_executor
tools.description: Execute a structured, schema-validated query against a registered dataset. Never accepts raw SQL. All fields must match the dataset schema returned by datawarehouse_query_schema.

tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Get step-by-step workflow guidance for iceDQ operations. Topics: create_validation_rules, create_recon_rules, create_checksum_rules, create_duplicate_rules, create_pushdown_rules, groovy_expressions, async_monitoring, scheduling_pipelines, and more.
